# Prompt Regression Lab

> Run deterministic regression checks over prompt outputs using required claims, forbidden phrases, structural contracts and length budgets. Use when changing system prompts, agent instructions, templates, or model providers.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/qasimrazamalik-coder/prompt-regression-lab
License: MIT
Primary instructions: skill/SKILL.md
Installation: docs/INSTALLATION.md
Safety guardrails: docs/GUARDRAILS.md
Security policy: SECURITY.md
Example input: examples/input.json

## Supported runtimes
Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, MCP-compatible agents, and custom agent runtimes.

## Usage
Run: python skill/scripts/run.py examples/input.json
Test: pytest -q
